<section class="mod_article grid-center block" id="article-1000">
<div class="grid">
<div class="ce_text col-12_md-8 block">
<h1>On your boards, get set, go! Surfing and kitesurfing on Fehmarn</h1>
<h2 class="ce_headline col-12">Wulfen Surf Area: Germany's Biggest Surf Spot</h2>
</div>
<div class="ce_image col-12_md-3 block">
<figure class="image_container">
<img src="files/bilder/logos-auszeichnungen/Auszeichnungen%202024/logo_windsurfing_wulfen%20%281%29.jpg" width="293" height="103" alt="">
</figure>
</div>
<div class="ce_text col-12_lg-6 block">
<p>If you&rsquo;re vacationing at the Wulfener Hals camping and vacation park, you&rsquo;ll be right next to Germany&rsquo;s largest surf spot. Experts and beginners alike come from all over to surf and kiteboard in Wulfen on Fehmarn.</p>
<p>The Wulfener Hals surfing spot on Burger Binnensee is a real hit with surfers and one of the most popular spots on the Baltic Sea island. Because the water is mostly shallow, safe surfing is possible in almost all wind and weather conditions. It&rsquo;s also perfect for kids who want to try surfing for the first time&mdash;they&rsquo;ll make new friends right away in the small beginner classes and have a blast burning off some energy together.</p>
</div>
<div class="ce_text col-12_lg-6 block">
<p><strong>But speed lovers will also get their money's worth here&mdash;without compromise. </strong></p>
<p>Extremely shallow water makes freeriding a dream from wind force 4 onward&mdash;power jibes and water starts are a breeze here. Pros and wave enthusiasts will find one of the island&rsquo;s best wave spots on the open Baltic Sea&mdash;separated from Burger&rsquo;s inland lake only by a wide sandy beach&mdash;when the wind is blowing from the east.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="mod_article full-width marg-top block" id="article-1001">
<div class="text-bild-links">
<div class="ce_text block">
<h2>"Windsurfing Wulfen" Surf School</h2>
<p>If you want to learn to surf or simply improve your skills, the &ldquo;Wulfener Hals&rdquo; is the perfect place for you. It&rsquo;s home to one of Germany&rsquo;s leading surf and catamaran schools, the Surfschule Windsurfing Wulfen. From early April through late October, up to 12 experienced VDWS instructors teach beginners, advanced surfers, adults, teens, and kids ages 6 and up, starting with the &ldquo;Bambini&rdquo; courses.</p>
<p>At the surf shop and rental station, you can rent or purchase equipment from leading manufacturers. For sailors, Hobby Cats &amp; Topscats are available, and for stand-up paddlers, there&rsquo;s everything your heart desires. At the &ldquo;Wulfener Hals,&rdquo; you have the opportunity to get started in windsurfing or improve your surfing skills. Learn kitesurfing in small groups and experience the thrill of catamaran sailing. Phone: 0157 504 319 91</p>
<p><a href="http://www.windsurfing-wulfen.de" target="_blank" rel="noopener">www.windsurfing-wulfen.de</a></p>
</div>
<div class="ce_image block">
<figure class="image_container">
<picture>
<source srcset="assets/images/f/Surfschule_Camping_WulfenerHals_Fehmarn5775-a1dc8dad.webp 1x, assets/images/7/Surfschule_Camping_WulfenerHals_Fehmarn5775-540e5796.webp 1.25x" media="(min-width: 48em)" type="image/webp" width="2000" height="900">
<source srcset="assets/images/7/Surfschule_Camping_WulfenerHals_Fehmarn5775-ef6712e3.jpg 1x, assets/images/4/Surfschule_Camping_WulfenerHals_Fehmarn5775-a9520591.jpg 1.25x" media="(min-width: 48em)" width="2000" height="900">
<source srcset="assets/images/9/Surfschule_Camping_WulfenerHals_Fehmarn5775-4a667f88.webp" type="image/webp" width="2500" height="1667">
<img src="files/bilder/Strand%20%26%20Freizeit/Strand%20%26%20Meer/Surfen%2C%20kiten%2C%20segeln/Surfschule_Camping_WulfenerHals_Fehmarn5775.jpg" width="2500" height="1667" alt="" loading="lazy">
</source></source></source></picture>
</figure>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="mod_article grid-center block" id="article-1007">
<div class="col-12_md-10">
<h2 class="ce_headline col-12">
Windsurfing Lessons at the "Wulfener Hals" on Fehmarn</h2>
<div class="ce_accordionStart ce_accordion ">
<div class="accordion-toggle"><i class="fal fa-plus"></i><span>Beginner Courses</span></div>
<div class="accordion-content">
<div class="ce_text block">
<p>In our beginner courses, you can choose between a week-long course or a weekend intensive course. In just 12 hours, you&rsquo;ll learn to windsurf in a small group in a fun and relaxed way. Our licensed windsurfing instructors ensure your safety on the water and help you get the most out of your learning experience. In addition to the basic techniques, you&rsquo;ll gain fundamental knowledge about the rules, potential hazards, and equipment. The course concludes with the internationally recognized VDWS Basic Certificate, which allows you to windsurf in all areas requiring a license and to rent equipment worldwide.</p>
<p><strong>To register, please call 0157 504 319 91</strong></p>
</div>
</div>

<section class="mod_article full-width marg-top block" id="article-1003">
<div class="bild-text-bild-skew-right">
<div class="ce_image block">
<figure class="image_container">
<picture>
<source srcset="assets/images/e/DSC09888-3c0f00fa.webp" type="image/webp" width="2500" height="2500">
<img src="files/bilder/Strand%20%26%20Freizeit/Strand%20%26%20Meer/Surfen%2C%20kiten%2C%20segeln/DSC09888.jpg" width="2500" height="2500" alt="" loading="lazy">
</source></picture>
</figure>
</div>
<div class="ce_text block">
<h2>Kitesurfing on Fehmarn&mdash;at one of the best kitesurfing spots on the Baltic Sea</h2>
<p>Seeing the colorful sails in the sky is a magnificent sight! <strong>When the wind is blowing from the southeast, Wulfen is probably the best kitesurfing spot in Germany</strong> And recreational athletes from all over the world appreciate that. Using lines about 20 meters long, they let themselves be pulled out of the water by stunt kites with a wing area between 5 and 15 square meters and reach tremendous speeds on special kiteboards even in winds as low as force 2. Anyone who wants to take up this sport should be physically fit and a strong swimmer. A good way to get started is to gain some initial experience with a conventional stunt kite.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<div class="ce_image block">
<figure class="image_container">
<picture>
<source srcset="assets/images/c/DSC07273-13fcaf41.webp" type="image/webp" width="2500" height="2500">
<img src="files/bilder/Strand%20%26%20Freizeit/Strand%20%26%20Meer/Surfen%2C%20kiten%2C%20segeln/DSC07273.jpg" width="2500" height="2500" alt="" loading="lazy">
</source></picture>
</figure>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="mod_article grid-center block" id="article-1005">
<h2 class="ce_headline col-12">Want to learn how to kitesurf?</h2>
<div class="ce_text col-12_lg-6 block">
<p>Then let the pros show you the ropes at one of the best kiteboarding spots on the Baltic Sea! Experienced VDWS instructors will teach you in small groups in shallow waters that are ideal for beginners. At the start, you&rsquo;ll learn all the necessary safety procedures to ensure a safe start. The surf school offers the first session as a 4-hour block with a maximum of four students per instructor. The curriculum includes all safety-related exercises and equipment training, as well as kite handling, and launching and landing the kite in the water and on land.</p>
</div>
<div class="ce_text col-12_lg-6 block">
<p>In subsequent training sessions, we&rsquo;ll use progressive exercises to improve your kite control and practice water starts and other maneuvers. We offer various options, each lasting 3 hours with 4, 3, or 2 students per instructor. You choose how intensive your instruction should be. Courses run daily from Easter through the end of October, by appointment and weather permitting. Secure your spot: For information on courses and bookings, call 0157 504 319 91.</p>
<p><a href="http://www.windsurfing-wulfen.de" target="_blank" rel="noopener">www.windsurfing-wulfen.de</a></p>
</div>
</section>

<img src="files/bilder/Strand%20%26%20Freizeit/Strand%20%26%20Meer/Surfen%2C%20kiten%2C%20segeln/Firefly%2020250110101353-2.jpg" width="2048" height="1152" alt="" loading="lazy">
</source></source></source></source></source></picture>
</figure>
</div>
<div class="ce_text block">
<h2>Wingfoil Courses in Wulfen on Fehmarn</h2>
<p>Are you interested in the latest water sports trend? Then you've come to the right place! Windsurfing Wulfen offers you the chance to try it right here on Fehmarn at the Burger Binnensee <strong>Wingfoil</strong> to learn. Wingfoiling, also known as wingsurfing, is a combination of windsurfing, kitesurfing, and foiling.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.windsurfing-wulfen.de/foilen.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">More Info</a></p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="mod_article block" id="article-2080">
<div class="grid-center"><div class="col-12_md-10">
<div class="ce_text block">
<h2>Prices for Beginner Courses</h2>
<p>The basics of wing surfing with plenty of hands-on practice.</p>
</div>
<div class="ce_table preistabelle block">

</tr>

<section class="mod_article full-width marg-top block" id="article-1006">
<div class="bild-text-bild-skew-right">
<div class="ce_image block">
<figure class="image_container">
<picture>
<source srcset="assets/images/6/Fehmarn_Wulfener_Hals_Burger_Binnensee_015-4e551794.webp" type="image/webp" width="2000" height="1314">
<img src="files/bilder/Strand%20%26%20Freizeit/Strand%20%26%20Meer/Surfen%2C%20kiten%2C%20segeln/Fehmarn_Wulfener_Hals_Burger_Binnensee_015.jpg" width="2000" height="1314" alt="" loading="lazy">
</source></picture>
</figure>
</div>
<div class="ce_text block">
<h2>Cast Off&mdash;Catamaran Sailing on the Baltic Sea</h2>
<p>HobieCat&mdash;glide across the water on two hulls&mdash;here you'll discover the thrill of catamaran sailing and learn the basics in just 12 hours.</p>
<p>Here, too, you can choose between a week-long course or a compact weekend course. The course culminates in the internationally recognized VDWS Basic Certification, which allows you to sail a catamaran and rent equipment in all areas where a certification is required. The beginner&rsquo;s course is your introduction to the world of catamaran sailing. From Easter through the end of October, our courses start daily by arrangement, depending on wind conditions.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<div class="ce_image block">
<figure class="image_container">
<picture>
<source srcset="assets/images/1/Fehmarn_Wulfener_Hals_Burger_Binnensee_017-d02a8f96.webp" type="image/webp" width="2000" height="1326">
<img src="files/bilder/Strand%20%26%20Freizeit/Strand%20%26%20Meer/Surfen%2C%20kiten%2C%20segeln/Fehmarn_Wulfener_Hals_Burger_Binnensee_017.jpg" width="2000" height="1326" alt="" loading="lazy">
</source></picture>
</figure>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<div class="ce_text block">
<h2>Want to go surfing, but don't have your own gear?</h2>
<p>No problem. New windsurfing gear from leading manufacturers is waiting for you on the beach. For sailors: Hobie Cats, Topscats, and KLs, as well as stand-up paddleboarding equipment.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.windsurfing-wulfen.de/vermietung.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">More Info</a></p>
